WITH fe AS (
    SELECT ge.id
    FROM "GenericEntityService"."GenericEntities" ge
    INNER JOIN "SettingsService". "Templates" template on ge."templateId" = template.id        
    WHERE template."name" = 'clinical_study_session_group' OR template."name" = 'label'
)
SELECT 
ge.name, 
TO_TIMESTAMP(ge."customAttributes" ->>'start_time', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MSZ') as start_time,
TO_TIMESTAMP(ge."customAttributes" ->>'end_time', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MSZ') as end_time,
concat('value: ', ge."customAttributes"->'value', ', details: ', ge."customAttributes"->'details_json') as value_and_details_json
FROM "GenericEntityService"."GenericEntities" ge 
INNER JOIN "SettingsService"."Templates" t ON ge."templateId" = t.id
LEFT JOIN fe on fe.id::text = ge."customAttributes" -> 'session_group' ->> 'id'
WHERE ge.name in (${PatientLabels:singlequote}) and t.name = 'label'
AND ge."customAttributes" -> 'label_patient' ->> 'id' = '$Patient'

SELECT ge.name, 
  (LEFT(ge."customAttributes" ->> 'start_time', 23) || 'Z')::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' as start_time,
  (LEFT(ge."customAttributes" ->> 'end_time', 23) || 'Z')::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' as end_time,
-- TO_TIMESTAMP(ge."customAttributes" ->>'start_time', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MSZ') as start_time,
-- TO_TIMESTAMP(ge."customAttributes" ->>'end_time', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MSZ') as end_time,
  concat('value: ', ge."customAttributes"->'value', ', details: ', ge."customAttributes"->'details_json') as value_and_details_json
FROM "GenericEntityService"."GenericEntities" ge
INNER JOIN "SettingsService"."Templates" template on ge."templateId" = template.id        
WHERE ge.name in (${DeviceLabels:singlequote}) and
template."name" = 'label' AND (ge."customAttributes"->'label_device'->>'id' in (${PatientsTingoDevice:singlequote}) OR 
                                     ge."customAttributes"->'label_device'->>'id' in (${PatinetCgmDevices:singlequote}))
                          -- OR ge."customAttributes" -> 'label_patient' ->> 'id' = '$Patient'

WITH dose_solution AS (
  SELECT ge.id, ge.name
  FROM "GenericEntityService"."GenericEntities" ge
  INNER JOIN "SettingsService"."Templates" template 
    ON ge."templateId" = template.id        
  WHERE template."name" = 'dose_solution'
)
SELECT   
  ds.name as sol_name,   
  (LEFT(ge."customAttributes" ->> 'time', 23) || 'Z')::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' as start_time,
  (LEFT(ge."customAttributes" ->> 'dose_end_time', 23) || 'Z')::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' as end_time,
  concat('device id: ', ge."customAttributes"->'device_dose'->>'id', ', amount (U): ',ge."customAttributes"->'amount', ', rate of injection (U/min): ', ge."customAttributes"->'rate_of_injection') as "details"
FROM "GenericEntityService"."GenericEntities" ge
INNER JOIN "SettingsService"."Templates" template 
  ON ge."templateId" = template.id    
INNER JOIN dose_solution ds 
  ON ds.id::text = ge."customAttributes"->'dose_label_solution'->>'id'
WHERE template."name" = 'dose_label' 
AND (ge."customAttributes"->'device_dose'->>'id' IN (${PatientsTingoDevice:singlequote})
    OR ge."customAttributes"->'device_dose'->>'id' IN (${PatinetCgmDevices:singlequote}))
  -- and ge."customAttributes"->'patient_dose'->>'id'  = '$Patient'

SELECT
  ge.name, 
  (ge."customAttributes" ->> 'start_time')::timestamptz as start_time,
  (ge."customAttributes" ->> 'end_time')::timestamptz as end_time,
  concat(
    'value: ', ge."customAttributes"->'value', 
    ', details: ', ge."customAttributes"->'details_json'
  ) as value_and_details_json
FROM "GenericEntityService"."GenericEntities" ge 
INNER JOIN "SettingsService"."Templates" t ON ge."templateId" = t.id
WHERE t.name = 'label'
  AND  ge."customAttributes" -> 'session_group' ->> 'id' = '$session_group_id'

WITH hw AS (
  SELECT ge.id, ge.name
  FROM "GenericEntityService"."GenericEntities" ge
  JOIN "SettingsService"."Templates" t ON ge."templateId" = t.id
  WHERE t.name = 'hw'
)
SELECT
  sess.id,
  sess."deviceId",
  hw.name                                            AS hw_id,
  CASE
    WHEN sess.state = '0' THEN 'active'
    WHEN sess.state = '1' THEN 'done'
    ELSE sess.state
  END                                                AS state,
  sess."startTime",
  sess."endTime",
  sess."customAttributes"->'current_app_version'     AS app_version,
  sess."customAttributes"->'current_fw_version'      AS fw_version,
  sess.summary
FROM "DeviceService"."SessionsV2" sess
LEFT JOIN hw ON hw.id::text = sess."customAttributes"->'hw'->>'id'
WHERE sess."patientId" = '$Patient'
  AND (
       (sess."startTime" >= $__timeFrom() AND sess."startTime" <= $__timeTo())
    OR (sess."endTime"   >= $__timeFrom() AND sess."endTime"   <= $__timeTo())
    OR (sess."startTime" <= $__timeFrom() AND (sess."endTime"  >= $__timeTo() OR sess."endTime" IS NULL))
  )
ORDER BY sess."startTime" DESC

WITH interval_cte AS (
  SELECT GREATEST(1, FLOOR(
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz))
    / ${w_pixels:raw}
  ))::int AS interval_seconds
),
device_label AS (
  SELECT
    d.id AS sid,
    d.id || ' (' || COALESCE(ev."customAttributes"->>'family_name', 'NONE') || ')' AS label
  FROM "DeviceService"."Devices" d
  LEFT JOIN "GenericEntityService"."GenericEntities" el
    ON el.id::text = d."customAttributes"->'electrode'->>'id'
  LEFT JOIN "GenericEntityService"."GenericEntities" ev
    ON ev.id::text = el."customAttributes"->'electrode_electrode_version'->>'id'
  WHERE d.id IN (${PatientsTingoDevice:singlequote})
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN '${Binning}' = 'Yes'
    THEN time_bucket(make_interval(secs => (SELECT interval_seconds FROM interval_cte)), bm.time)
    ELSE bm.time END                          AS time,
  AVG(bm.value)                                      AS value,
  COALESCE(dl.label, bm.sid)                         AS device_ver
FROM biot_measurements bm
LEFT JOIN device_label dl ON dl.sid = bm.sid,
interval_cte
WHERE bm.pid = '$Patient'
  AND bm.sid IN (${PatientsTingoDevice:singlequote})
  AND bm.measure_name = 'current'
  AND bm.time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND bm.value BETWEEN ${Min_current_view:raw} AND ${Max_current_view:raw}
GROUP BY
  CASE WHEN '${Binning}' = 'Yes'
    THEN time_bucket(make_interval(secs => (SELECT interval_seconds FROM interval_cte)), bm.time)
    ELSE bm.time END,
  COALESCE(dl.label, bm.sid)
ORDER BY time

WITH interval_cte AS (
  SELECT GREATEST(1, FLOOR(
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz))
    / ${w_pixels:raw}
  ))::int AS interval_seconds
),
device_label AS (
  SELECT
    d.id AS sid,
    d.id || ' (' || COALESCE(ev."customAttributes"->>'family_name', 'NONE') || ')' AS label
  FROM "DeviceService"."Devices" d
  LEFT JOIN "GenericEntityService"."GenericEntities" el
    ON el.id::text = d."customAttributes"->'electrode'->>'id'
  LEFT JOIN "GenericEntityService"."GenericEntities" ev
    ON ev.id::text = el."customAttributes"->'electrode_electrode_version'->>'id'
  WHERE d.id IN (${PatientsTingoDevice:singlequote})
),
glucose_sessions AS (
  SELECT sess.id AS usid, gc.name AS calc_ver
  FROM "DeviceService"."SessionsV2" sess
  JOIN "SettingsService"."Templates" t  ON t.id  = sess."templateId" AND t.name = 'glucose_measurement'
  JOIN "GenericEntityService"."GenericEntities" gc
    ON gc.id::text = sess."customAttributes"->'glucose_calculation_version'->>'id'
  JOIN "SettingsService"."Templates" tgc ON tgc.id = gc."templateId" AND tgc.name = 'glucose_calculation_version'
  WHERE sess."deviceId" IN (${PatientsTingoDevice:singlequote})
    AND gc.name IN (${GlucoseCalcVer:singlequote})
)
SELECT
  time_bucket(make_interval(secs => (SELECT interval_seconds FROM interval_cte)), bm.time) AS time,
  AVG(bm.value)                                                                             AS value,
  COALESCE(dl.label, bm.sid)
    || CASE WHEN gs.calc_ver IS NOT NULL THEN ' [' || gs.calc_ver || ']' ELSE '' END        AS uid_version_combined
FROM biot_measurements bm
LEFT JOIN device_label    dl ON dl.sid  = bm.sid
LEFT JOIN glucose_sessions gs ON gs.usid = bm.usid,
interval_cte
WHERE bm.pid = '$Patient'
  AND (
       (bm.sid IN (${PatientsTingoDevice:singlequote}) AND bm.usid IN (SELECT usid FROM glucose_sessions))
    OR  bm.sid IN (${PatinetCgmDevices:singlequote})
  )
  AND bm.measure_name = 'glucose'
  AND bm.time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY
  time_bucket(make_interval(secs => (SELECT interval_seconds FROM interval_cte)), bm.time),
  COALESCE(dl.label, bm.sid)
    || CASE WHEN gs.calc_ver IS NOT NULL THEN ' [' || gs.calc_ver || ']' ELSE '' END
ORDER BY time

WITH ref AS (
  SELECT time_bucket(interval '60 seconds', time) AS time, AVG(value) AS value
  FROM biot_measurements
  WHERE pid = '$Patient'
    AND sid IN (${PatinetCgmDevices:singlequote})
    AND measure_name = 'glucose'
    AND time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  GROUP BY 1
),
tingo AS (
  SELECT time_bucket(interval '60 seconds', time) AS time, AVG(value) AS value
  FROM biot_measurements
  WHERE pid = '$Patient'
    AND sid IN (${PatientsTingoDevice:singlequote})
    AND measure_name = 'glucose'
    AND time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  GROUP BY 1
),
joined AS (
  SELECT
    t.time,
    r.value                                        AS ref_value,
    t.value                                        AS tingo_value,
    100 * ABS(t.value - r.value) / NULLIF(r.value, 0) AS ard,
    CASE
      WHEN r.value BETWEEN   0 AND  50 THEN '1) 0-50'
      WHEN r.value BETWEEN  51 AND 100 THEN '2) 51-100'
      WHEN r.value BETWEEN 101 AND 150 THEN '3) 101-150'
      WHEN r.value BETWEEN 151 AND 300 THEN '4) 151-300'
    END AS ref_range
  FROM tingo t
  JOIN ref r ON r.time = t.time
),
range_counts AS (
  SELECT ref_range,
    COUNT(*)                                        AS total_points,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ard < 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)      AS points_below_10
  FROM joined GROUP BY ref_range
)
SELECT
  ref_range                                         AS "Glucose range (mg/dL)",
  points_below_10 * 100.0 / NULLIF(total_points, 0) AS "ARD < 10 (%)"
FROM range_counts
ORDER BY ref_range

SELECT time, value, sid || '-' || measure_name AS sid_measure
FROM biot_measurements
WHERE pid = '$Patient'
  AND sid IN (${PatientsTingoDevice:singlequote})
  AND measure_name = 'temperature'
  AND time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
ORDER BY time

WITH interval_cte AS (
  SELECT GREATEST(1, FLOOR(
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz))
    / ${w_pixels:raw}
  ))::int AS interval_seconds
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN '${Binning}' = 'Yes'
    THEN time_bucket(make_interval(secs => (SELECT interval_seconds FROM interval_cte)), time)
    ELSE time END                             AS time,
  AVG(value)                                         AS value,
  sid || '-' || measure_name                         AS device_measure
FROM biot_measurements, interval_cte
WHERE pid = '$Patient'
  AND sid IN (${PatientsTingoDevice:singlequote})
  AND measure_name IN ('cv_current', 'cv_voltage')
  AND time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY CASE WHEN '${Binning}' = 'Yes'
    THEN time_bucket(make_interval(secs => (SELECT interval_seconds FROM interval_cte)), time)
    ELSE time END, sid || '-' || measure_name
ORDER BY time

WITH interval_cte AS (
  SELECT GREATEST(1, FLOOR(
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz))
    / ${w_pixels:raw}
  ))::int AS interval_seconds
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN '${Binning}' = 'Yes'
    THEN time_bucket(make_interval(secs => (SELECT interval_seconds FROM interval_cte)), time)
    ELSE time END                             AS time,
  AVG(value)                                         AS value,
  sid || '-' || measure_name                         AS device_measure
FROM biot_measurements, interval_cte
WHERE pid = '$Patient'
  AND sid IN (${PatientsTingoDevice:singlequote})
  AND measure_name IN ('pert_current', 'pert_voltage')
  AND time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY CASE WHEN '${Binning}' = 'Yes'
    THEN time_bucket(make_interval(secs => (SELECT interval_seconds FROM interval_cte)), time)
    ELSE time END, sid || '-' || measure_name
ORDER BY time

SELECT time, value, sid || '-' || measure_name AS sid_measure
FROM biot_measurements
WHERE pid = '$Patient'
  AND sid IN (${PatientsTingoDevice:singlequote})
  AND measure_name IN ('mobile_battery', 'tingo_device_battery')
  AND time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
ORDER BY time

list.definition:
WITH glucose_calc AS (
  SELECT 
    ge.id AS gid, 
    ge.name, 
    ge."customAttributes"->'calculation_version_description' AS calculation_version_description
  FROM 
    "GenericEntities" ge
    INNER JOIN "Templates" ON "Templates"."id" = ge."templateId"
  WHERE 
    "Templates"."name" = 'glucose_calculation_version'
),
real_data AS (
  SELECT  
    glucose_calc.name AS gname
  FROM 
    "SessionsV2" sess
  INNER JOIN 
    "Templates" ON "Templates"."id" = sess."templateId"
  INNER JOIN 
    glucose_calc ON glucose_calc.gid::text = sess."customAttributes"->'glucose_calculation_version'->>'id'
  WHERE 
    sess."deviceId" IN (${PatientsTingoDevice:singlequote})
    AND "Templates"."name" = 'glucose_measurement'
),
dummy_row AS (
  SELECT 
    'None' AS gname
)
-- Combine the real data with the dummy row
SELECT gname
FROM real_data

UNION ALL

SELECT gname
FROM dummy_row
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM real_data
);
list.name: GlucoseCalcVer
list.query:
WITH glucose_calc AS (
  SELECT ge.id AS gid, ge.name
  FROM "GenericEntityService"."GenericEntities" ge
  JOIN "SettingsService"."Templates" t ON t.id = ge."templateId" AND t.name = 'glucose_calculation_version'
),
tingo_sids AS (
  SELECT sess."deviceId" AS sid
  FROM "DeviceService"."SessionsV2" sess
  JOIN "DeviceService"."Devices" d ON sess."deviceId" = d.id
  JOIN "SettingsService"."Templates" t ON d."templateId" = t.id
  WHERE sess."patientId" = '$Patient'
    AND t.name = 'tingo_device'
),
real_data AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT gc.name AS gname
  FROM "DeviceService"."SessionsV2" sess
  JOIN "SettingsService"."Templates" t ON t.id = sess."templateId" AND t.name = 'glucose_measurement'
  JOIN glucose_calc gc ON gc.gid::text = sess."customAttributes"->'glucose_calculation_version'->>'id'
  WHERE sess."deviceId" IN (SELECT sid FROM tingo_sids)
)
SELECT gname FROM real_data
UNION ALL
SELECT 'None' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM real_data)
ORDER BY 1
